title: Explorer River Tours

services.name: Expeditions Kayak Tours
services.desc: Blackstone River Expeditions is excited to offer 90-minute guided group kayak tours along the beautiful Blackstone River, departing from Central Falls Landing. Paddle through the heart of the Blackstone River Valley as experienced guides share stories of the river’s rich history and lead you to hidden spots you might otherwise miss. Along the way, keep your eyes open for incredible wildlife - from graceful egrets and painted turtles sunning on logs to cormorants, osprey soaring overhead, and even “Sam,” the river’s well-known lone mute swan. It’s the perfect way to explore, learn, and experience the natural beauty of the Blackstone Valley from a whole new perspective. Rentals are available
